ABOUT DR. CHETALI
Eighteen years of listening, looking deeper, treating gently.

A BHMS graduate from the University of Goa and a gold medalist in Dietetics from Maharashtra, Dr. Chetali brings rigorous clinical training to every consultation. Her practice spans acute illnesses and chronic concerns — with deep expertise in paediatrics, skin, hormonal balance, anxiety and depression.

Patients return year after year because they feel heard. You will leave each visit knowing what is happening, what to expect, and exactly when modern medicine should be the first call.

ABOUT
Dr. Chetali Damania

BHMS, Gold Medalist in Dietetics

For eighteen years, my work has been simple in intention and careful in practice: to listen closely, look at the whole person, and offer the quietest path back to health.

I trained at the University of Goa and went on to earn a gold medal in Dietetics from Maharashtra. That blend — clinical homeopathy with a strong nutritional foundation — shapes every consultation I do today.

BHMS
University of Goa
Gold Medalist
Dietetics, Maharashtra
18 years
Goa · Mumbai · Dubai · Punjab · Chandigarh · worldwide
A NOTE FROM DR. CHETALI
Why honest medicine matters.

Homeopathy is powerful when it’s the right tool. It is gentle, individualised, and works with the body rather than against it. But it isn’t the answer to every condition — and pretending otherwise does patients harm.

In every consultation, I’ll share my clinical opinion plainly. If allopathic care is faster or safer for what you’re facing, I will say so. If homeopathy can support healing alongside it, we’ll plan that together. The aim is always your wellbeing — never the loyalty to a system.

I see patients from Goa, Mumbai, Dubai, Punjab, Chandigarh and many more places around India and abroad — most online, some in person. What we build together is a long, calm conversation about your health.

CONDITIONS
What I treat — and where I’ll refer.

Eighteen years of practice across paediatrics, skin, hormonal health and mental wellbeing — held together by one principle: be honest about what homeopathy can heal, and what it cannot.

Paediatric care

Colic, recurrent colds, allergies, eczema, sleep, appetite and behavioural concerns — with the gentlest possible touch.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Acute emergencies and serious infections are referred to paediatric allopathy first.

Skin conditions

Eczema, psoriasis, urticaria, acne, lichen planus — addressed from constitution, gut and stress, not just topical creams.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Severe infections, melanomas and surgical lesions require dermatology referral.

Hormonal disorders

PCOS, thyroid imbalance, irregular cycles, perimenopause — supported with remedies and dietetics together.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Acute endocrine emergencies and surgical conditions need allopathic management.

Anxiety & depression

Calm, careful listening with constitutional remedies that complement therapy and lifestyle work.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Severe or suicidal presentations require psychiatric care; homeopathy supports alongside.

Acute illnesses

Fevers, viral infections, injuries, allergic flares — with clear escalation if conventional care is needed.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Red-flag symptoms always get an urgent allopathic referral.

Lifestyle & dietetics

Personalised nutrition rooted in Maharashtra gold-medal training, tuned to your constitution and routine.

WHEN TO LOOK ELSEWHERE

Not a replacement for surgical or pharmacological management when indicated.

Not sure if homeopathy fits your case?

A short consultation is the most honest way to find out.

OUR APPROACH
Three systems. One question: what helps you most?

Healing isn’t a competition between traditions. Each system has its strengths and its honest limits. Here’s how I think about choosing between them — and why I’ll always tell you the truth about both.

Homeopathy
MY PRACTICE

Like cures like — minute doses that prompt the body to heal itself.

STRENGTHS
Individualised to the whole person
Gentle, side-effect-free
Strong in chronic, recurring and constitutional conditions
HONEST LIMITS
Slower in some chronic cases
Not first-line for acute emergencies or surgery
Ayurveda

Balancing doshas through diet, lifestyle, herbs and detoxification.

STRENGTHS
Lifestyle and digestion-focused
Rich herbal pharmacopoeia
Preventive wisdom
HONEST LIMITS
Variable standardisation of formulations
Not designed for acute critical care
Allopathy

Targeting disease mechanisms with pharmacology, surgery and diagnostics.

STRENGTHS
Fast in acute and emergency care
Rigorous diagnostics and imaging
Essential for surgical and life-threatening conditions
HONEST LIMITS
Side effects in long-term use
Can overlook the whole-person context
How a consultation usually goes
1
A long, quiet conversation

We talk about your story — symptoms, sleep, stress, history, family. The full picture matters.

2
A clear clinical opinion

I’ll share my assessment in plain language, and what I’d recommend across systems.

3
A gentle, personalised plan

Remedy, dietary support and follow-up rhythm — built around your reality.

4
Open follow-ups

Adjustments are made as you respond. You’re never on your own between visits.
